morgan (JonesInc): Hey team — after a reconnect our client gets a truncated SSE stream. Final JSON event is incomplete and there is no finish_reason or [DONE] event. Non-streaming responses are fine.

maya (support): thanks — can you paste the exact curl you used and a minimal payload? also the request-id header from the failing call if available.

morgan (JonesInc): curl command below, token redacted. We reproduce consistently when our proxy re-establishes the connection (client-side reconnect).

```bash
curl -N \ \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","prompt":"...","stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```

Sample last chunk we received (truncated):

```sse
data: {"id":"resp_abc123","object":"text_completion","choices":[{"text":"...final tokens...","index":0,"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":
```

(maya): that looks like the connection dropped mid-json. do you see any http-level finish (like an event "[DONE]" or a trailing newline)?

morgan (JonesInc): No, it cuts exactly like above. No trailing [DONE]. Non-stream returns include finish_reason. Also our billing showed the streaming request counted as full tokens even though client only got partial last chunk.

sam (infra): pinging infra. can you also share the request-id header and region? might be a proxy or edge truncation.

morgan (JonesInc): request-id: req_20260315_77bd, region: us-west-2. Happened 8x this morning. Token is valid; auth works for rest endpoints.

leo (runtime): possible repro: client reconnects and resumes by opening a new HTTP/1.1 SSE connection; some proxies (and CDN edge nodes) will buffer and flush leading to partial last chunk. Also if gzip/transform happens it can truncate final chunk unless server sends a terminating newline.

maya (support): can you try two quick workarounds and report? 1) disable any proxy buffering (no-transform / Cache-Control). 2) keep the client open for 2s after receiving last event to let TCP finish.

morgan (JonesInc): tried no-transform; still saw truncation. Waiting 2s sometimes yields the final bytes, but inconsistent.

sam (infra): escalating to ops-bot — tagging P2. ops-bot, can we pull edge logs for req_20260315_77bd and adjacent requests to see whether TLS session reset or a 504 was proxied?

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20260315-84. Edge log query queued for req_20260315_77bd. Notified CDN vendor.

leo (runtime): also running a local repro against the runtime with a simulated reconnect. I can reproduce when the client issues a quick reconnect (within 100-200ms) — server's stream flush is fine, but the client reconnect path can open a fresh connection to a different backend that hasn't flushed the last bytes. That yields two things: (a) partial JSON on first connection, (b) no [DONE] because the final event hasn't been flushed to that new connection.

morgan (JonesInc): is there a suggested server-side patch we can rely on? this is breaking parse on our end and we have to implement fragile client-side heuristics.

leo (runtime): short-term mitigation: include an explicit "event: done\ndata: [DONE]\n\n" sentinel after completing the JSON body, plus send a final blank SSE comment line ":\n\n" to force proxies to flush. medium-term: we should add a last-chunk idempotent ack so reconnects can request missing tail bytes.

sam (infra): agree. add header to responses: "Cache-Control: no-transform, must-revalidate" and ensure keepalive comment lines are sent every 15s. ops-bot: mark follow-up for infra+runtime to add no-transform and explicit [DONE] event for streams.

morgan (JonesInc): thanks. will implement client-side: tolerate truncated last event by buffering until next event or 2s idle, and fallback to non-streaming on repeated truncation. Please keep me updated on permanent fix.

maya (support): filing a support ticket with the workaround and root-cause hypothesis: edge/CDN rebuffer + client reconnect. Ticket: TKT-5632. Assigned: leo (runtime).

ops-bot: TKT-5632 logged. Priority: P2.

leo (runtime): quick repro snippet for engs: server emits SSE like below. note the final sentinel we propose.

```sse
data: {"id":"resp_abc123","object":"text_completion","choices":[{"text":"...","index":0,"finish_reason":"stop"}]}
event: done
data: [DONE]
:

```

leo (runtime): I'll push a change to the streaming response layer to always send the "event: done" sentinel and final comment line before closing. will monitor for regressions.

maya (support): Thanks all — Morgan, I'll follow up once we've validated the edge rule and runtime change in staging. Can you confirm whether billing anomaly persists after you apply the client fallback?

morgan (JonesInc): will test and report. appreciate the quick triage.
